max_tokens.detail: Built and protected by the agent adapter; native JSON accepts caller input.

messages.detail: Runtime-owned history, source and title; native document context/cache/citations decorations are supported. Five pinned citation variants have typed output and private replay with offline fixtures. Custom-content documents, search-result inputs and live behavior remain unverified.

system.detail: Built and protected by the agent adapter; native JSON accepts caller input.

tools.detail: Runtime local tools and owned hosted/MCP declarations are protected. Managed models use frozen function options and provider authority. The separate beta MCP inventory covers server/toolsets and native use/result/listing replay; live and full nested semantics remain unverified.

model.detail: Immutable adapter model constructor; configure cannot replace it. Explicit raw-native JSON remains caller-owned.

output_config.detail: SDK configure; runtime output schema is protected when requested. Native JSON accepts caller input.

stream.detail: Agent uses SDK streaming; native client controls the request mode.

user_profile_id.detail: The adapter exposes a userProfileId header; native JSON accepts this body field separately.

cache_control.detail: Immutable agent options, or typed/native configure for models without managed tools; explicit raw JSON also accepts the field. Forwarding does not prove full nested or live semantics.

container.detail: Explicit immutable initial container ID/object, including skills. Returned IDs are retained privately, take precedence and remain protected across paused and local-tool continuation. Live expiry/files remain unverified.
